palette: celadon brick grid, alum paper tiles, procuratorate cinnabar, court indigo, police pine green, relay-banner ochre
typography: WenKai way-station headings with stamped node badges and courier route chips
composition: twin vertical command lines with drop connectors, a central police hub ringed by four outpost posts with a walled prison post, and a three-plaque rule stack beside a city-level filing route ladder
surface: a courier relay yard paved with celadon bricks, paper notices nailed to posts and vermilion seals on route tags
motion: command lines draw downward between node badges, outpost cards peg themselves around the hub, and the filing route climbs rung by rung to the city level
transition: the brick yard and header rail persist while the relay boards are rearranged
